# Separator

A separator element accessible to screen readers.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/separator`: `Separator`, `SeparatorPrimitive`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Separator } from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<Separator />
```

## API Reference

### Separator

Styled wrapper for `Separator` from Base UI. Renders as a horizontal line by default with muted background color.
